svg.aria-label: For every suite and every other allocator, one dot per workload showing how much faster bcmalloc is
svg.title: How bcmalloc compares, workload by workload
svg.text: How bcmalloc compares, workload by workload
Each dot is one workload: bcmalloc's speed divided by the other allocator's, on a log scale. Right of the dashed line,
bcmalloc is faster. The bar is the geometric mean. Medians of every run, from benchmarks.json.
Dots beyond the ends of the axis sit at the ends. Workloads that measure memory are left out, and so is the latency group.
